name: Free From the Hold
summary: Gilthares Firebough is held at Northwatch Hold after Alliance forces sink his ship off the Barrens coast. The elf deckhand wants to reach his captain in Ratchet.

sections.title: Imprisoned at Northwatch
sections.body: Gilthares Firebough is held in the dungeons at Northwatch Hold. Theramore uses the fortress as its military foothold on the Barrens coast, where its garrison watches for threats. Gilthares had been aboard a ship carrying moonshine along the trade route between Ratchet and Booty Bay when Alliance forces bombarded it and sent it beneath the sea. He alone survived the wreck. The soldiers took him to Northwatch and accused him of being an enemy agent conspiring against the Alliance.

sections.title: A Smuggler's Flight
sections.body: Gilthares says he is only a deckhand who was carrying illicit liquor. With help from Horde forces, he fights his way out of Northwatch Hold and flees north along the shore toward Ratchet. Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun welcomes him back to the crew of the Thalo'dan Privateers.

aliases: who is the prisoner in northwatch hold
faq.answer: Gilthares Firebough is an elf deckhand sailing under Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun. He served aboard a transport carrying moonshine between Ratchet and Booty Bay before Theramore troops sank the vessel and imprisoned him.

faq.q: Why was Gilthares arrested by Theramore forces?
faq.answer: Alliance soldiers at Northwatch Hold intercepted Gilthares's ship off the Barrens coast and blasted it into the sea. Wary of maritime traffic near their stronghold, they condemned him as an operative hostile to the Alliance.

faq.q: Where does Gilthares go once freed?
faq.answer: Gilthares flees north from Northwatch Hold along the Barrens' eastern shore to Ratchet. There, he rejoins Captain Brightsun by the docks.

The Thalo'dan Privateers are a maritime crew led by Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun and based in Ratchet. They ship goods and smuggle bootleg moonshine across the sea between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why is Northwatch Hold attacking civilian or smuggler ships?
faq.answer: Northwatch Hold is Theramore's fortress in the Barrens, between Horde territory and key sea routes. Its commanders' paranoia and strict military orders lead them to see nearly any non-Alliance ship as a Horde operation or pirate threat.

faq.q: What cargo was the sunken ship carrying?
faq.answer: The sunken vessel carried illicit moonshine for distribution between Ratchet and Booty Bay, not weapons or military supplies.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can strike at Theramore's foothold on the Barrens coast by freeing a smuggler held at Northwatch Hold.
